title: Pilot timing and the rollout
request: A manager asked an AI assistant: 'The weekly digest says staff finish the new form in under five minutes. Can we roll it out to everyone?'

subject.description: The AI assistant's answer to the request.

segments.text: Yes, roll the new form out to everyone.
The pilot showed that staff finish it in under five minutes.
18 of 20 staff finished the new form in under five minutes.
All 20 used the current browser. The form was not tried on the older browser that some offices still use.
